verdict.rationale: Firecrawl ships a built-in AI agent that takes a task in natural language ('Describe what you need'), then searches, navigates and retrieves the result with no URLs required. Users can set how much reasoning it spends, and agent jobs are first-class asynchronous jobs with webhook notifications. Its scope is limited to web data gathering rather than general product assistance, and the evidence is mostly brief README lines. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on agent capabilities and limits, delegation beyond retrieval tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent quality.
